adminHelp: In OBS, add a browser source on the overlay address. To push an alert from another tool:
noToken: No sending code set: only the test alert works. To set one: “Settings” tab, “Sending code” option (advanced mode).
ytHelp: Super Chats, Super Stickers and memberships on your YouTube live appear here, one after the other. They come from the YouTube live actions module, which reads the chat **only while its “Live” page is open**: keep it open during the live. Message texts stay hidden unless you tick “Show the text of YouTube messages” in the settings.
ytTestError: The test alert could not be prepared.
ytAbsent: To also show Super Chats and memberships from your YouTube live, install the “YouTube live actions” module.
tw_f_min_gift: Smallest number of gifted subs shown
tw_f_min_help: Smaller ones are not shown. Empty or 0 shows everything.
tw_intro: Choose which Twitch events appear on screen, and how they read.
tw_preset_ok: The {style} style is applied to every type.
tw_f_template_help: Plain words. Words between braces are replaced: {name} {count} {amount} {tier} {months} {viewers} {level} {title} {text} {total}. Empty restores the default sentence.
tw_f_seconds_help: Between 2 and 60 seconds. Empty uses the duration of the Settings tab.
tw_err_type: This type does not exist. Reload the page, for example with F5.
tw_err_template: Unknown word: {words}. Use only {vars}, for example {name} follows you.
tw_err_long: The text is too long. Write {n} characters at most, for example Thanks {name}.
tw_err_seconds: Write a whole number from {min} to {max}, for example 8.
tw_err_min: Write a whole number from 0 to {max}, for example 100.
q_running: Alerts are running. Waiting to be grouped: {n}.
q_paused: Alerts are paused. {n} held, they come out when you resume.
q_pause_ok: Paused: new alerts are held, nothing is lost.
tw_f_sound_help: Made by the page itself, nothing is loaded. Heard only if sounds are switched on.
tw_f_image_help: A picture of your site, shown above the text. PNG, JPG, WebP or GIF.
tw_err_choice: This choice does not exist. Pick one from the list, for example Chime.
tw_err_image: This picture could not be kept. Send it again, for example a PNG of 200 px.
tw_simulate_btn: Show a sample evening on screen
tw_simulate_ok: {n} sample alerts sent: they come one after the other, as on stream.
vw_intro: Choose what the text of viewers does on screen, and whether alerts are read aloud.
md_intro: Pictures, GIFs, videos and sounds that your bot commands can show on stream.
tw_f_video_help: Add videos in the Media tab.
tw_f_video_sound: Play the sound of the video
tw_f_tts_help: Needs the voice, switched on in the Viewer texts tab.
tw_f_viewer_help: Shown after the sentence, if the viewer wrote one.
tw_err_video: Pick a video that you added, for example Video 1.
tw_err_gif: Add a picture first, for example a GIF.
tw_err_viewer_max: Write a whole number between {min} and {max}, for example 140.
tts_f_voice_help: The voices come from your computer.
tts_f_lang_help: Empty: the language of the site.
tts_f_name: Read the name of the person
tts_test_message: This is a test of the voice.
tts_test_ok: Sample sent. Open the overlay in OBS to hear it.
tts_err_off: The voice is off. Switch on the voice and save, for example with Read alerts aloud.
tts_err_range: Write a number between {min} and {max}, for example 1.
tts_err_lang: Write two letters, for example en or fr.
tts_state_unknown: No overlay page has reported yet. Open the overlay in OBS once.
tts_state_nosupport: The overlay page cannot read aloud. OBS may be too old.
tts_state_novoice: The overlay page sees no voice. Install a voice on the computer that runs OBS.
tts_state_muted: The voice is on but muted from the dock.
tts_state_ok: The voice is ready: {n} voices seen by the overlay page.
mod_f_hold_help: Hide the text only, or hold the whole alert for you.
mod_f_words_example: For example: one word per line
mod_f_words_help: Empty by default. Case and accents do not matter.
mod_err_words: The list is too long. Keep 4000 characters at most.
mod_limits: This is a basic filter. It does not replace Twitch AutoMod.
mod_empty: No text is waiting. Refused texts will appear here.
mod_accepted: Accepted. The alert shows again with its text.
mod_err_unknown: This text is not waiting any more.
tw_f_audio_help: Plays instead of the chosen sound. Needs sounds switched on.
tw_err_audio: Send a sound of the site, for example an MP3 file.
md_delete_confirm: Delete this file? It is removed from your site, and the commands that use it show nothing.
md_empty: No file yet. Add a picture, a GIF or a sound.
md_err_name: Write a name of 40 characters at most. For example: Applause.
md_err_dup: This name is already used. Pick another, for example: Applause 2.
md_err_file: Send a file with the button, for example a PNG, GIF or MP3.
md_err_full: The library is full ({max} files). Delete some before adding more.
md_err_unknown: This file does not exist (any more).
md_err_busy: Too many files shown in a minute. Try again in a moment.
page_intro: Your Twitch events and the alerts they show on screen.
types_intro: What your site receives from Twitch, and what each event shows on screen.
status_listening: Your site is listening to Twitch ({n} types on).
check_ok: All good: Twitch is sending to your site.
creds_steps: First connect your Twitch application in the [Twitch connector]({href}).
no_channel_steps: Add your channel in the module My Twitch channel, then come back.
revoked_note: Twitch stopped a subscription on {when}. The page repairs it by itself when possible.
listen_no_channel: No Twitch channel found on your site yet.
listen_channel_unknown: The chosen channel is not known to your site.
listen_slow: My Twitch channel does not answer.
listen_creds_missing: Your Twitch application is not set up yet.
listen_need_connect: Your channel is not connected to Twitch yet.
listen_need_reconnect: The connection to Twitch has expired. Connect again to receive events.
listen_site_private: Twitch cannot reach your site: it needs a public secure address (https).
listen_twitch_down: Twitch does not answer right now. The page tries again by itself.
listen_twitch_busy: Twitch asks to slow down. The page tries again by itself.
listen_refused: Twitch refused a subscription. Check that your Twitch connection is complete.
listen_nothing_on: Every type is switched off. Switch one on in the tab Event types.
switch_need_more: {type}: switched on. Twitch's permission is still needed, see the top of the page.
type_sub_help: A new subscriber, gifted ones included.
type_resub_help: A subscriber renews with a message.
type_gift_help: Someone gives one or several subs.
type_hype_help: A hype train starts, levels up and ends.
empty: No event yet. Send a test from the tab Event types to see what it looks like.
replay_ok: Replayed: the alert goes out again.
remove_confirm: This line is removed from the journal. Alerts already shown do not change.
test_ok: Test sent: it appears in the journal and in your alerts.
err_unknown_type: This type does not exist. Reload the page, for example with F5, then try again.
err_unknown_line: This line no longer exists. Reload the page, for example with F5.
err_rate: Too many tries in a minute. Wait ten seconds, for example, then try again.
dock_intro: In OBS, open the menu Docks, then Custom browser docks. Give it a name, paste the address below and apply.
dock_renew_help: The address is a secret. Make a new one if it was shared by mistake.
dock_renew_confirm: The dock in use stops working at once. Reload the dock in OBS with the new address.
dock_renewed: New address made. Paste it in the dock of OBS.
dock_denied: This address is not the right one. Copy the current address from the page of your site.
dock_search_none: No line matches. Clear the search.
dock_empty_hint: New events appear here by themselves.
dock_no_alerts: The alerts queue does not answer. Try again in a moment.
dock_paused_note: Alerts paused, {n} held until you resume.
dock_err_rate: Too many tries. Wait a little.
dock_err_site: The site does not answer. Trying again.
dock_clear_confirm: Empty the waiting alerts and the screen?
dock_listening_off: Not listening to Twitch. Open the module
health_silent: No event for {n} hours while you are live. A quiet stream is normal: click Check now to be sure.
catchup_note: After a gap, {n} lines were added from Twitch ({when}) and are marked possibly missed.
health_mail_off: To be warned by e-mail when listening stops, set up the e-mail of your site first.
mail_subject_problem: Your site no longer receives your Twitch events
mail_subject_back: Your site receives your Twitch events again
mail_body_back:
All is back since {since}. Nothing to do.
{link}
dock_no_voice: The voice does not answer. Try again in a moment.
dock_muted_ok: Voice muted until you unmute it.
reason_unconfirmed: Twitch has not confirmed this one, the others are fine. It is created again once.
reason_unreachable: Twitch cannot reach your site's address.
reason_elsewhere: Another module already receives this from Twitch, so nothing reaches this page.
rx_cell_title: What shows on screen when this happens. Use Edit to change it.
rx_f_pick_help: At random, never twice in a row.
rx_err_unavailable: The reaction could not be saved. Try again in a moment.
rx_err_limit: At most {max} files. Remove one, for example the last.
rx_err_file: This file is not allowed. Choose a PNG, JPEG, WebP or GIF picture, or an MP4 or WebM video.
rx_err_kept: A file could not be kept. Send it again, for example from the button Add files.
rx_err_audio: Choose an MP3, OGG, WAV, M4A or AAC sound, for example ding.mp3.
rx_err_words: Unknown word between braces. Use only {vars}, for example {name}.
rx_err_long: The sentence is too long. Keep it under 120 characters, for example a short thanks.
rx_err_seconds: Write a whole number from 2 to 60, for example 8.
rx_err_choice: Choose one of the proposed values.
cl_placed: Alerts placed in an overlay page
cl_placed_title: This page cannot tell whether the element is in an overlay page. Check it there.
listen_taken: Another module already receives this from Twitch: {list}. Nothing reaches this page.
reason_failed_revoked: Twitch stopped it because the permission was withdrawn. Connect again to Twitch.
reason_failed_unreachable: Twitch stopped it because your site did not answer in time. It is created again.
reason_failed_other: Twitch stopped it. It is created again.
retry_waiting: Started again: {type} waits for Twitch's answer.
retry_taken: Another module already receives {type} from Twitch. Switch it off there first.
reason_create_failed: Twitch refused to start it. Its answer: {detail}.
rx_err_compose: The text placed on a picture is not valid. Open Place the text on that picture, then save.
rx_f_min_gift: Smallest number of gifted subs shown
rx_f_min_help: Smaller ones are not shown. Empty: all of them.
rx_f_tts_help: Needs the voice, switched on in the Viewer texts tab.
rx_f_viewer_help: Shown after the sentence, if the viewer wrote one.
rx_err_min: Write a whole number from 0 to 1,000,000, for example 500.
rx_err_viewer_max: Write a whole number from 20 to 250, for example 140.
rw_count_title: One reaction per reward, in the Rewards tab
rw_intro: A different reaction for each channel point reward.
rw_type_off: Switch on “Channel points” in the Event types tab →
rw_scope: Allow reading the rewards in the Event types tab →
rw_na: Your channel has no channel points: it must be Affiliate or Partner.
rw_twitch_down: Twitch does not answer: only the rewards already seen are listed.
rw_add_need_bot: To create a reward from here, add the Twitch bot →
rw_add_need_scope: To create a reward from here, authorize the Twitch bot →
rw_add_too_many: The Twitch bot already handles 20 rewards: remove one to create another.
rw_gone_title: This reward no longer exists on Twitch. You can remove its reaction (⋯ menu).
rw_same_title: Shows the reaction of all the other rewards
rw_others_title: The reaction of the rewards that have none of their own
rw_empty: No reward yet: create one with “Add a reward”.
rw_forget_confirm: The pictures, videos, sounds and placed texts of this reward will be removed. It will show the reaction of the other rewards.
rw_err_unknown: This reward no longer exists. Reload the page.
rw_err_full: At most 100 rewards can have their own reaction.
rw_err_others: This line cannot be removed: it is the reaction of all the other rewards.
rw_e_title: Write a name, for example Hydrate.
rw_e_title_long: 45 characters at most, for example Hydrate.
rw_e_dup: This name is already used on your channel. Choose another one, for example Hydrate 2.
rw_e_cost: Write a whole number of points, for example 500.
rw_e_prompt: Help text too long: 200 characters at most.
rw_e_denied: Your account may not create rewards of the Twitch bot.
rw_e_na: Your channel has no channel points: it must be Affiliate or Partner.
rw_e_rate: Twitch asks to wait a little. Try again in a minute.
rw_e_too_many: The Twitch bot already handles 20 rewards: remove one to create another.
rw_e_need_scope: Allow the Twitch bot to manage your rewards, then try again.
rw_e_need_connect: Connect your channel in the Twitch bot, then try again.
rw_e_need_reconnect: Reconnect your channel in the Twitch bot, then try again.
rw_e_twitch: Twitch did not answer. Try again in a moment.
ho_waiting: Taking over Twitch activity: this needs a minute. Its alerts keep showing meanwhile.
ho_need_update: Update Twitch activity to version 1.13.0 to finish moving it here.
ho_guest_link: Twitch listening and journal: open the first copy →
opt_mail_help: One e-mail per problem, and one when all is back.
opt_silent: Warn when live without any event for
opt_err_range: Write a whole number between {min} and {max}, for example {max}.
two_sounds: Play a sound with each alert
two_sounds_help: The sound chosen for each type.
two_text: Show the messages that come with an alert
two_text_help: Resub, bits and reward messages, after moderation.
two_ignore_help: Separated by commas. Their events show no alert.
two_group_help: Gifts and follows close together become one alert.
two_err_group: Write a whole number between {min} and {max}, for example 5.
two_err_ignore: The list is too long: 2000 characters at most.
